title: GFPrint™: A machine learning tool for transforming genetic data into clinical insights.
summary: The paper applies its learned streaming representation and unsupervised clustering to two public cancer-genomics datasets, reporting gene panels associated with worse survival in colorectal, lung and pheochromocytoma cohorts and pathway-level findings. This is an exploratory retrospective result on public cohorts with no prospective validation or demonstrated clinical utility. AI role: GFPrint™ streaming feature embedding and unsupervised clustering. The article appeared in PLOS ONE.
